intent: R2dbcHistoryStoreTest runs the real V1 migration DDL on embedded H2 and asserts: appended row read back; duplicate identity adds zero rows; an update attempt fails while a corrective entry appends under a new sequence; a foreign tenant's read returns nothing (cross-owner); a request for 500 rows returns at most 50 (PB-14 page-size-limit, deterministic-count); keyset order holds; spring.r2dbc.pool.max-size reads 10 (PB-17 pool-limit).

methods.semantics: true when the row was inserted; false for a duplicate identity (nothing written)

methods.signature: Mono<Boolean> appendUsage(String sessionId, String turnId, String tenantId, int promptTokens, int completionTokens)
methods.semantics: true when the usage row was inserted; false when the session id + turn id already has one (duplicate)

methods.signature: Flux<HistoryEntry> byIdAndTenant(String sessionId, String tenantId, String afterTurnId, int afterSequence, int limit)
